entries.body: Slow Sunday. Long walk by the river with Sam, then soup and a chapter of the new book. Feeling rested for the week.
Finally finished the bookshelf project. Took all afternoon but it looks great in the hallway.
Busy day at work, too many meetings. Skipped the gym. Early night.
Woke up with a headache and the train was late. Better by the evening after a call with Mum.
Good feedback on the presentation. Celebrated with tacos.
Rainy and grey. Cleaned out the fridge and planned meals for the week.
